battlecards.why_selected: Highest savings (33%), strong service fit verified during site visits, enthusiastic about business, could start immediately.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU drafted 8/6/24 – pricing fixed through 4/30/25 with quarterly business reviews; no volume commitment penalties.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to award full corrugate volume and threat of single-supplier consolidation; multiple BAFO rounds drove price concessions.
supplier_weaknesses: Limited reach to FL/AL operating companies
Does not supply other packaging categories
battlecards.switching_costs: Spec verification and artwork approval for ~200 SKUs; minor retraining of warehouse teams.

battlecards.why_selected: National reach to cover all OpCos, acceptable savings, willingness to hold pricing for 12-months, favorable payment terms.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU drafted 8/6/24 – 12-month price hold, option to extend 2 x 12 months with CPI caps ≤3%.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to award both packaging and labels lots; threat to consolidate with Landsberg if terms not met.
supplier_weaknesses: Historic service concerns at Get Fresh – FE to monitor KPIs closely
battlecards.switching_costs: SKU cross-references and internal system updates for ~500 items.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered lower overall savings (18%) and limited bid coverage; staggered implementation limited value.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as price-check against Welch/Bunzl in BAFO to drive additional 1-4% concessions.
supplier_weaknesses: Did not bid full spend initially
battlecards.notes: Kept engaged as future contingency supplier.

battlecards.why_selected: Matched target pricing (within $30K of lowest), avoided operational disruption, proximity to Indy Fruit warehouse.
battlecards.contract_terms: MOU effective 5/1/24-4/30/25 with fixed pricing (48x40 #2 = $3.99, buy-back $1.49); quarterly volume updates.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Credible threat to shift to 48Forty, plus detailed usage data provided to all bidders.
battlecards.switching_costs: Freight lanes and pallet spec alignment, reverse logistics set-up.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Additional ~$30K savings versus Kamps did not justify change-over costs and risk.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Their low bid used to pressure Kamps to match targets.
supplier_weaknesses: Unknown service performance with produce distributors
battlecards.switching_costs: System updates, trailer spotting, pallet spec validation.

alternatives_considered: 5 other suppliers via Freedom Energy Logistics
battlecards.why_selected: 48-month fixed price balanced short-term cost with long-term risk mitigation; best NPV over 4-year horizon.
battlecards.contract_terms: 48-month all-requirements contract starting 5/14/24; fixed $0.06558/kWh; utility billed.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Broker ran sealed bid among 6 suppliers; FE/market intel showed upward price trend, prompting supplier concessions.
battlecards.switching_costs: Early termination fees if market falls; account enrollments via utility.
battlecards.notes: Projected total contract savings $61K vs market forecast.

battlecards.why_selected: Nationwide fuel network, consolidated discounts, single invoice & real-time reporting; lowest net cost after rebates.
battlecards.contract_terms: Net-billing with cost-plus ¢/gal markup and quarterly volume rebates; no long-term volume commitment.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: 165+ trucks across 8 OpCos created large volume; threat of staying with fragmented suppliers.
supplier_weaknesses: Slightly higher pump prices in some metro areas
battlecards.switching_costs: Card replacement, driver training, back-office integration to TMS.
battlecards.notes: Implementation being led by WPP consultant; go-live Q4-2024.
